---
title: "Downsizing at Doomsday Cult Central"
date: "2007-02-07"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

The prolific Felix Salmon [gets the boot](http://www.rgemonitor.com/blog/economonitor/176532 "gets the boot") from Nouriel Roubini’s RGE Monitor.  I always thought Felix was too much of an independent thinker for Doomsday Cult Central.  Felix can now be found at [his own site](http://www.felixsalmon.com/000580.html#comments "his own site").  In an email, Felix says:

> *this time round I don’t have people telling me what kind of attitude to take, in terms of either style or substance*
